scripts.text:
[Lella]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Leaf Cats?
scripts.translation:
[莱拉]
你猎杀够50只群叶猫了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Lella]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:

嗯，你好像还没猎杀够50只...

scripts.text:
[Lella]
Remember, I need help hunting Leaf Cats so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[莱拉]
记住，我需要你帮忙猎杀群叶猫，去杀够50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Lella]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[莱拉]
确定要放弃狩猎吗？
目前的任务进度都会清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lella]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[莱拉]
好吧，改变主意了就回来找我。

scripts.text:
I really need to gather ^00CE0050 Huge Leafs^000000 for my sanity.
Do you have any?
scripts.translation:
我急需^00CE0050巨大叶子^000000，不然真要疯了。
你身上有吗？

scripts.text: I have 50 Huge Leafs
scripts.translation: 我有50片巨大叶子

scripts.text: What, sorry I was day dreaming
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉，我刚才走神了

scripts.text:
[Lella]
Wonderful I can tell it is just a little bit quieter around here!
scripts.translation:
[莱拉]
太好了，周围的声音好像真的小了点！

scripts.text:
[Lella]
The more leafs I collect the quieter it seems around here.
scripts.translation:
[莱拉]

scripts.text:
[Lella]
Meow meow meow meow meow...
NOOOOOOOOOOOO.
scripts.translation:
[莱拉]
喵喵喵喵喵...
不——！！！

scripts.text:
[Lella]
I need ^00CE0050 Huge Leafs^000000.

[Lella]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Leaf Cats.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[莱拉]
好，那就帮我猎杀些群叶猫吧。
你打算猎杀多少只？
